notes.title: Update v1.6.4
notes.notes:
Updated the resolution upscaling algorithms to their latest versions: DLSS 4 and FSR 3.1.
These versions should introduce less upscaling artifacts.

notes.title: Patch v.1.4.1
notes.notes: Corrected a bug that did not allow users using a keyboard only to define the name of a created course or exercise.

notes.title: Update Notes for v1.4.0
notes.notes:
A photo mode is now available on the pause menu (save Steam screenshots with F12)
 Now when the horse touches a pole it becomes more attentive (it gains a jump quality/height bonus for some time thereafter), like in real life
 Minor re-balancing of horse stats
 Improved lighting performance on internal arena

notes.title: Update notes for v1.3.3
notes.notes: New option: Joystick drift prevention. If you are experiencing joystick drift (the horse turning all the way left/right if you let go of the joystick) then try increasing this parameter from "Standard" to "High" or "Very High".

notes.title: Update notes for v1.3.2
notes.notes: Each obstacle now has 3 color variants

notes.title: Update v1.2.8
notes.notes:
- Better memory management.
- Corrected lightmap artifact in external arena.
- Slightly improved performance.

notes.title: Update notes for March 3
notes.notes:
[olist]
 Corrected minor bug (null object exception)
 Fine-tuned external/internal arena probabilities
[/olist]

notes.title: Update notes for March 2nd
notes.notes:
An external arena is now available!
When loading a course, a random selection will be made between the external and internal arenas.
